experiment: Non-activated Android native one-unit vs greedy same-budget packing; JA and SW

policy.A: Unchanged normal default route and single-unit starter; every row must reproduce retained final full/direct spans, mixed text, trace and native ranges. No results credited until all 768 pass.
policy.B: Call exact current per-pair loader for all hits/guards. Keep null-reason hits in original stable category-content-first/train_rank ascending/source-token length descending/start ascending order. Greedily accept each whole nonoverlapping unit if its exact native word cost fits remaining budget. No re-ranking, alternate target or new entry.
policy.budget: 0.25; max(1,floor(actual native words * density)), identical to current native policy. Existing source-known exclusions unchanged.
policy.presentation: Re-use actual SourceReferencePresentation.create plus existing evidence.filterPartial and normal ConversationImmersion sourceLookup injection. Report direct starter separately from complete route; authored reference priority remains.
policy.masks: All original recognitions, exact approved IDs/ranges and protected masks retained including blocked/known candidates; immutable original pack references remain.
policy.normalization: Only unchanged native loader matching/ICU LocalImmersion.words. No Python tokenization or recreated guards.
policy.limits: No translations/models; no changes to production sources; no Apple build; historical diagnostic inputs, not population coverage.

review.root_subset: Per pair take first 20 changed message IDs ordered by SHA256(pair+NUL+id), retaining all three states; separately first 4 unchanged source IDs by same ordering. No outcome/label backfill. Full packet retains all 768 cases.
review.author: Review every newly emitted source-face/context plus full changed messages; preserve prior judgments.
review.prior_exposure: All baseline sources exposed historical diagnostics; new output meanings not tuned or used for selection.

bounds.capture_reservation: Measured APK+2*DEX+retained BOOT_PEAK+64MiB+output reserve, calculated at admission.

familiarity: Proposal only, separate from exclusions; no persistence/actions/scheduler/automatic mastery or rendering behavior changes.
